Subject: Acme activation: vendor setup and initial security artifacts request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the intro — we want to get Redwood set up in our vendor system so we can issue a PO and kick off the pilot. Before finance will create a PO we need the following items from Redwood: 

- Fully executed DPA (or a DocuSign link we can accept)
- Current SOC 2 report or a link to an access portal where we can review the report
- Current subprocessor list (for our privacy team)
- The vendor setup form that your portal requires (we'll fill it)
- Billing/contact details (legal company name, billing entity, remit-to email, tax id or equivalent)

Can you send those items or point me to where we can download them? Also confirm your standard payment terms and whether Acme can request net-45 for this engagement (we sometimes request net-45 for trial agreements).

We'd like to close the vendor setup early next week. If there's someone on your side who owns PO routing and tax forms, please loop them in.

Thanks,
Lynn Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
procure@acmecorp.com

Thanks Jasmine — got the links and form. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we route to AP: 

1) Billing entity: our legal/commercial team wants to confirm the remit-to legal name and tax id to populate the PO. Can you provide Redwood's Tax ID (EIN) for US payments?

2) PO terms: Acme typically issues Net-45 on pilot contracts. If Neha confirms approval we'll accept Net-45.

3) W-9: our AP requires a W-9 (or equivalent tax certificate) for vendors paid in the US. Can you attach that?

4) DPA: will your DocuSign link produce a fully executed copy once both parties sign? We need to keep a signed copy in our records.

If you can cc your finance contact (Neha) on the response and include the W-9, we should be able to push this through by Friday.

Regards,
Lynn
